Crafted from PITAKA's Cadmyra™ material, which is strong yet flexible. It keeps the high strength and wear resistance of aramid fiber, resisting warping and fading over time, while offering the soft, refined feel of leather or fabric.
Made for commuting and travel. Just tap to pay without taking the card out, and one-handed use keeps every step quick and smooth.
Built-in N52-grade magnets lock the wallet onto any MagSafe-compatible device, so it will not slip out of a pocket or bag. It holds 1-2 cards securely for instant access.
A precision-engineered metal layer sits between the card compartment and the magnets to block magnetic interference. Your cards stay protected and fully functional.
At just 38 grams the slim wallet feels almost weightless, and its ergonomic shape stays comfortable in the hand all day.
